Pipeline Team For Vets For Partners News Contact Get updates Company news Press release · October 21, 2026 Familiar Therapeutics Launches with $5 Million Seed to Close the Gap Between Human and Veterinary Medicine In its first five months, Familiar has built 13 programs for dogs and cats, signed several pharma partnerships, filed a provisional patent and opened two drug development files with FDA CVM. Programs span oncology, neurology, cardiology, respiratory disease, and immunology, with the company's first clinical study set to open at the University of Illinois Veterinary Teaching Hospital this fall REDWOOD CITY, Calif.: Familiar Therapeutics launched today with $5 million in seed funding to bring the advances of modern human medicine to dogs and cats.
